questions.stem: Which method would you use to separate an insoluble solid from a liquid?
questions.explanation: Filtration is used to separate an insoluble solid from a liquid. The liquid (filtrate) passes through the filter paper while the solid particles (residue) are too large to pass through and remain on the paper.

questions.stem: What is the key difference between simple distillation and fractional distillation?

options.text: Simple distillation uses heat but fractional distillation does not
Fractional distillation uses a fractionating column to separate liquids with different boiling points
Simple distillation separates liquids but fractional distillation separates solids
There is no difference between them

questions.explanation: Fractional distillation includes a fractionating column (packed with glass beads) that allows repeated condensation and re-evaporation. This makes it effective for separating miscible liquids with different boiling points, such as ethanol and water.
